comment.narrative: As described in the interim report security context in the camps during the reporting period the targeted killings of the Rohingya community leaders and youth and their potential coopting with the armed groups under duress or otherwise caused delays and necessitated a review of this activity. Moreover since the targeted audience of this activity i.e. community members with prominent voices are precisely the profiles being threatened with violence and death in the camps currently in line with the Do No Harm principle it was decided to review this activity. It is now provisionally planned that informationsharing will be targeted towards youth volunteers working with INGOs.

The learning tools developed under the action were shared with the 140 Rohingya learnersyouth leaders through the network of Survivor Advocates and messages on community groups. Further capacity building sessions to discussion the topics indepth were scheduled in July 2024 however due to the protests and political crisis in Bangladesh the sessions could not be held before the end of activities date of the action. Nevertheless the learning tools were shared with the youth leaders who primarily focus on education and peacebuilding in the community. This will be continued in the next phase of the Action after considering the security situation in the camps and the risk profile of being a community leader and human rights defender.

Further capacity building sessions to discussion the topics indepth were scheduled in July 2024 however due to the protests and political crisis in Bangladesh the sessions could not be held before the end of activities date of the action. Nevertheless the learning tools were shared with the youth leaders who primarily focus on education and peacebuilding in the community. This will be continued in the next phase of the Action after considering the security situation in the camps and the risk profile of being a community leader and human rights defender.
